subject: OCCURS clause
notes: kb/Work PB1261 (wave 1015 Y). cite.py --check 13.18.38.3 "If the OCCURS clause is specified in an entry subordinate to one containing the GLOBAL clause, data-name-1, if specified, shall be a global name" -> OK 18). Format 2: OdoResolve asks DependingAttributeFault; a table in a global record (its own GLOBAL clause or a GLOBAL FD's, 8.4.6.2.2) whose data-name-1 is not in a global record draws COBOL2788. Format 3: ResolveReportOccursDepending applies the same answer under a GLOBAL RD (13.18.27.3 SR1 e)). 'Described in the same data division' holds by construction (OdoResolve runs inside Bind, before a contained program inherits container names).
